issues.title: make MaxFollowRedirects part of Client, not Request
issues.body:
this is a more sensible place for it. also request gets reset in the
middle of the fetch cycle so it isn't stable

issues.title: make it so .Do() can also follow redirects
issues.body:
this passes tests so i believe it is still working with the .Get()
family of functions. which leads me to believe it also will now work
with .Do(), given that they share a code path

issues.title: fix up uri encoding tests
issues.body:
i noticed these were broken when i attempted to run tests. we should
make sure that nothing in these changes looks too troublesome

issues.title: BodyDecompressed() method for req and resp
